name: When Police May Arrest Without Warrant
description: Lays down circumstances where police can arrest without prior approval from a magistrate.

name: Person Arrested to Be Informed of Grounds of Arrest
description: Mandates informing the arrested individual of the reasons for arrest and their rights.

name: Examination of Arrested Person by Medical Officer
description: Ensures a medical examination of the arrested person if they claim injuries or maltreatment.

name: Person Arrested Not to Be Detained More Than 24 Hours
description: No person can be detained by the police for more than 24 hours without being presented before a magistrate.

name: Order for Maintenance of Wives, Children, and Parents
description: Provides a legal remedy for maintenance to wives, children, and parents unable to support themselves.

name: Information in Cognizable Cases
description: Details the procedure for filing an FIR (First Information Report) in cognizable offences.

name: Police Officer's Power to Investigate Cognizable Cases
description: Grants the police the authority to investigate cognizable cases without prior approval of a magistrate.

name: Procedure When Investigation Cannot Be Completed in 24 Hours
description: Allows a magistrate to extend detention during an investigation, subject to specified conditions.

name: Cognizance of Offences by Magistrates
description: Describes how magistrates can take cognizance of offences upon receiving a complaint, police report, or other information.

name: Prosecution of Judges and Public Servants
description: Requires prior sanction for prosecuting public servants and judges for acts done in their official capacity.

name: Examination of Complainant
description: Mandates examination of the complainant on oath when a magistrate takes cognizance of a complaint.

name: Postponement of Issue of Process
description: Allows a magistrate to inquire into a case further before issuing a process against the accused.

name: Issue of Process
description: Authorizes a magistrate to issue a summons or warrant after taking cognizance of an offence.

name: Supply to the Accused of Copies of Police Report and Other Documents
description: Ensures the accused receives copies of relevant documents to prepare their defense.

name: When Accused Shall Be Discharged
description: Provides for the discharge of the accused if the magistrate finds no sufficient ground for proceeding.

name: Framing of Charge
description: Mandates the framing of charges if sufficient grounds exist to proceed against the accused.

name: Evidence for Prosecution
description: Allows the magistrate to record evidence for the prosecution when the accused does not plead guilty.

name: When Accused Shall Be Discharged in Warrant Cases
description: Empowers the magistrate to discharge the accused if no case is made out even after recording prosecution evidence.

name: Compensation for Accusation Without Reasonable Cause
description: Provides for compensation to the accused if the complaint against them is found to be malicious or without reasonable cause.

name: Non-Appearance or Death of Complainant
description: Allows the magistrate to acquit the accused if the complainant does not appear in a summons case.

name: Power to Postpone or Adjourn Proceedings
description: Empowers courts to postpone or adjourn proceedings as necessary during trials.

name: Power to Examine the Accused
description: Enables the court to question the accused to explain any evidence against them.
